about: Answers written the way students really write them — slips, Singlish, a right idea buried in waffle, half an idea in clumsy words, a near miss, passage words lightly changed — each at a mark the writer is sure of. Read with: run.ts --hard --plan-only, then plan.ts export / import, then run.ts --hard --report-only.
